additional_info.subject: RE: ID0430967-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R7 170002205]  Outlet DC2 CRM:02682000138
additional_info.body:
Dear Milan,
I hope you are doing well.
Regarding outlet DC2, please note that there is already an active ticket ID0428881 in the RC-CZ queue concerning a broken cable. Kindly plan a site visit to address this issue.
Additionally, we are currently observing a converter error with the following SR:
2102312VGQKXNB000025SA002200000205
, we recommend the following troubleshooting steps:
Check the display of the power converter to see whether it is in the ON or OFF state.
Try swapping the power converter with a known good one. If the error flag transfers to the replaced unit, the original converter is likely faulty.
If the above steps do not resolve the issue and the converter is still identified as faulty, we recommend replacing it, as rework is not possible.
Please use the following MLFB for ordering the spare converter:8EM5903-0AA01-0AA2
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
